title: RECKON v2 - Synthetic Indian Hospital Bills (10k pages)
subtitle: 10,212 generated bill pages, 21 layouts. No real patient data.
description:
Fully SYNTHETIC corpus of Indian hospital bills and discharge summaries, generated for the RECKON v2 document-understanding project (https://github.com/Abhiii4545/hospital-llm).

CONTAINS NO REAL PATIENT DATA. Every value is generated. Hospital names are invented and a test asserts no real hospital brand can appear. No real logo, trademark or letterhead is reproduced. GSTINs are structurally valid with correct check digits but correspond to no registered entity.

CONTENTS
- 10,212 page images (JPEG, ~794x1123 before augmentation)
- One JSON per page with per-head extraction targets: head_a (hospital, patient, insurance, totals) and head_b (line_items for that page)
- manifest.jsonl with a SHA-256 per page, split, layout, scan quality and messiness labels
- corpus_hash.txt, an order-independent hash of the whole corpus

STRUCTURE
- 21 layouts across 7 archetypes: corporate itemised, grouped-with-subtotals, sparse nursing home, minimal bilingual government, diagnostic test panel, pharmacy sub-bill with batch/expiry, discharge summary with billing annexure
- Diversity is STRUCTURAL, not cosmetic: column order, header placement, totals placement, table style and rows-per-page all vary. Column order in particular, because that is what a fixed-order regex cannot survive
- Bilingual headers in Telugu and Devanagari, restricted to states where those scripts are actually used
- Splits: train 8,163 / val 1,015 / synth_test 1,034, stratified by layout so every layout appears in every split

SCAN QUALITY (Augraphy)
clean 20% / light 35% / medium 30% / heavy 15%. Non-uniform because real claim intake is. Pages failing an Otsu-based legibility guard fall back to the clean render; the manifest records both the requested `quality` and the applied `quality_effective`, and slice analysis should key off the latter.

DELIBERATE MESSINESS
Missing UHID 8%, misaligned totals 5%, a row reprinted across a page break 12%, handwritten correction 6%. The duplicated row is printed but deliberately absent from the target - the assembly layer has to notice it.

GROUND TRUTH
The label is the exact string that is printed. Formatting and truth come from one code path, so a label cannot disagree with the pixels.

LIMITATIONS
- No true handwriting; corrections are rendered in a script font
- Only Telugu and Devanagari bilingual headers
- No real paper; every degradation is simulated
- Region weighting, ward distribution and tariffs are plausible guesses, not census or real rates
- Synthetic-test performance is an optimistic bound and is NOT a claim about real documents

Regenerable deterministically from a seed: see reckon/data/build_corpus.py in the repository. Full datasheet: docs/DATASHEET.md.
